decisions.reason: As a recently launched compliance-related product line with visible standalone presentation, multiple variants, and an early positive agency-focused signal, management is likely to justify and continue the investment rather than withdraw it quickly.

Because the web hosting management platform was promoted on the home page and directly supports the firm's announced expansion of agency platform features, management is especially likely to stay committed despite any uncertainty.

Although less visibly highlighted than Product B, the configurable managed hosting plan is close to the core business and recent enough that disappointing uptake can still be seen as temporary, so management would probably retain it.
